compatibility.notes: Verification remains non-repairing by default; fixing discovered defects requires a separate implementation capability.

do_not_use_when.text: The work is in active implementation and no completion claim has been issued
Repository truth itself is unverified and must be re-established before any completion claim

use_when.text: Completion claims can be stated precisely enough to test against an independent evidence matrix
An independent verdict is more valuable than another implementation or review pass

evidence_outputs.description: Reproducible claim-to-evidence matrix and check outcomes.
evidence_outputs.name: verification_receipt

inputs.description: Work product whose completion claims must be independently checked.
inputs.name: artifact_or_repository

inputs.description: Claims or acceptance criteria that define the asserted done state.
inputs.name: completion_claims

inputs.description: Prior tests or receipts that may inform but cannot substitute for independent verification.
inputs.name: prior_results

outputs.description: Claim-to-evidence matrix and reproducible checks another person can inspect.
outputs.name: receipt_bundle

preconditions.description: Consequential completion claims can be stated precisely enough to test.

capability.purpose: Independently test completion claims and produce a reproducible evidence-backed verdict.

requirements.description: Each consequential completion claim is mapped to evidence or an explicit gap.
Strongest practical deterministic or inspectable checks are executed independently.
Skipped, unavailable, failed, and unverified checks are visible in the verdict.
